about: What to type, per vertical. Each entry is one prompt and the use case it runs. Banking text is the catalog's own chip text (data/usecases.json trigger.text, verbatim; a test pins it). Healthcare and retail wording is lab-written for the same use cases (lab-invented, a test proves each one runs its use case). Stub verticals have no demo pack yet, so no prompts.

banking.text: check my sensitive account details for group entitlement
check my sensitive account details for tier access
Check for unusual patterns in my recent activity
Explain why my last blocked action was denied and walk me through the token chain

healthcare.text: check my sensitive patient records for group entitlement
check my sensitive patient records for tier access
